previous_paragraph: Meeting the Red Lines: Threshold Targeting and Minority Equity among Chinese Property Developers. Restricted-data public inspection archive, refreshed under T084 on 16 November 2026. Cite the archive release/commit and access date. No DOI is assigned. The PI publishes.

This archive includes accepted code/results through T076 (Hong Kong control), and T082's accepted build-interface, environment and documentation changes. T082 was accepted by PI override on 16 November; the remaining escalation concerned append-only historical input drift, not a detected estimate change. See process/state/approvals.log and process/review/. The run_all entry points have the same 28 ordered steps as the accepted internal package: 03 runs after 23 with --embed-proposal-fonts, then 24 and 25. Both integration switches MTPA_INTEGRATE_PROPOSAL and MTPA_INTEGRATE_SLIDES default off; do not enable them in this archive. They are historical opt-in integration modes, not part of ordinary reproduction.

HK raw CSVs (HKEX roster and public EastMoney statements) and their verified MANIFEST are in data/raw/control_hk/. The derived HK control panel and membership retain their independently public provenance. All third-party provider terms remain applicable. 25_hk_control.R uses those raw inputs with MANIFEST checks; its full estimation additionally requires the licensed developer panel and accepted upstream results. Controls are current listings/reporting-complete survivors, with differential advance-item missingness; the same-market comparison does not remove developer-specific shocks. See accepted support, imputation-robustness tables and process/state/LIMITATIONS.md.

T077: code/26_identification.R and permitted outputs/tables/t077_* and figures/t077_*. Accepted by PI override on 14 November. These window-probability/triple contrasts differ from the proposal's polynomial excess-mass estimand. The memo was outcome-informed; pretrend and sparse-support limitations remain. HonestDiD sensitivity was NOT RUN. T077 is not added to run_all: integration requires a separate decision. Firm-level analysis panels/membership and potentially licensed audit inventories are withheld. T078–T081 and later analyses are not included as research code/results; their cards/reviews are historical process records, not endorsements or newly released research.

Wind raw files, full/extended panels and firm-specific Wind-derived outputs are absent. The two firm-observation validation scatterplots are withheld because their coordinates include Wind financial values; see validation/T084_GRAPHICAL_PROVENANCE.csv. The public panel removes every Wind-sourced firm and twelve ownership/industry/sample columns under the accepted T073 policy; it is an inspection dataset, not a substitute analysis sample. Do not rename it to the full panel. Aggregated estimates are included under the PI release decision. Field-level provenance and exclusions are in WITHHELD.md, data/processed/PUBLIC_PANEL.md and OUTPUT_INVENTORY.csv. Hand-coded files preserve source, page and pending PI-verification flags; their inclusion is not fresh verification. Ownership coding lacking complete primary-source provenance remains withheld.

A full standalone rebuild is NOT verified or currently possible. T082 accepted safe build interfaces and documented historical integrity gates, external sibling inputs and audit/PDF reproducibility gaps; it did not certify a full build. The current internal README snapshot is process/replication_README.md. Install prerequisites separately from environment.lock and software/ before any offline run. run_all stops at the missing licensed Wind register in 01_clean.R. Obtain your own Wind licence and the exact exports listed in that script; additional external project inputs are still required by later steps. Do not weaken guards or fabricate replacements. Full runtime is unmeasured; bootstrap-heavy stages can take hours.

Safe available components and their exact blockers are tested on an isolated copy from this archive in validation/DRY_RUN.md. REPRODUCIBILITY.csv maps supplied scripts to outputs and dependencies. Fetchers require network/provider access and are not run. No downloads, new estimates or substitute data are authorized by T084.

code/, run_all.R/sh, environment.lock: accepted analysis sources and entry points. data/raw/: permitted public provider data and original coding, without third-party PDFs. data/processed/: reduced inspection panel and removed-field provenance. outputs/: permitted aggregate results and independently public controls. process/: scripts, roles, cards, reports, decisions, AI-use record, notes and historical team diagrams, with its own README and source/public checksums. audit/ retains the sanitized T073 layout for compatibility. Numerical prose in public process narratives is conservatively redacted; use accepted code/tables for exact numbers. Local originals remain unchanged. Third-party PDFs have recorded URLs/checksums in process/THIRD_PARTY_DOCUMENTS.csv; unrecorded URLs are explicit. External referee reports and students' work are excluded.

validation/: source integrity, every sanitizer hit/handling, output rechecks, HK checksums, dry run and anonymity occurrences. The author-name/initials/account report includes text, PDF metadata and raw-byte occurrences. This named working archive is not automatically anonymous. The mirror's name replacement does not sanitize image text or Git authors; the PI must review remaining identifiers and transport metadata before publication. No Git command, commit or push was run by T084. Existing .git is left untouched and is not payload. MIT covers original code; LICENSE-data.md covers only author-held rights. No provider licence or permission to redistribute third-party copyrighted files is asserted.

MANIFEST.csv covers every payload file except itself, plus explicit withheld records; .git is transport metadata excluded from scans/manifest. See validation/T084_ANONYMITY.md before pushing either named or anonymous versions.
